local nicepeople = 100 -- change this 

for i,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and game.Players.LocalPlayer:DistanceFromCharacter(v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position) < nicepeople then
local hook; hook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
   local args = {...}

       args[3] = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
   end
   return hook(self, unpack(args))
end))
end
end
